newsHighlights.title: Xi attends state dinner held by Trump
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping delivered a speech rich in substance at the state dinner hosted by US President Donald Trump.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席在特朗普总统举行的国宴上发表了内容充实的讲话。

newsHighlights.title: Chinese, US first ladies visit National Museum of Asian Art
newsHighlights.summary: Peng Liyuan and the US first lady toured the National Museum of Asian Art and admired works that carry centuries of Asian culture.
newsHighlights.translation: 彭丽媛与美国第一夫人参观了美国国家亚洲艺术博物馆，欣赏承载数百年亚洲文化的艺术作品。

newsHighlights.title: Xi, Peng Liyuan visit US National Archives with Trump and his wife
newsHighlights.summary: The two presidential couples visited the US National Archives, a landmark that guards the documents of a nation's memory.
newsHighlights.translation: 两国元首夫妇共同参观美国国家档案馆，这座建筑保存着一个国家记忆的文献。

newsHighlights.title: Documentary filmmaker shares stories of kindness
newsHighlights.summary: A documentary filmmaker recounts how a 7-year-old Chinese boy gave his birthday egg to an injured American airman after the Doolittle Raid.
newsHighlights.translation: 一位纪录片导演讲述二战期间一名7岁中国男孩把自己的生日鸡蛋送给受伤美国飞行员的感人故事。

newsHighlights.title: US teacher thrilled as his story reaches the White House
newsHighlights.summary: An American teacher was thrilled to learn that his story of friendship across the Pacific had reached the White House.
newsHighlights.translation: 一位美国教师得知自己关于跨太平洋友谊的故事传到白宫后激动不已。

quote.quote: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中一页。
quote.explanation: 旅行让人接触不同的文化与生活方式，拓宽视野；正如本次中美元首夫妇的博物馆、档案馆之行，文化之旅本身就是增进理解、沟通心灵的桥梁。

vocabulary.example: The president's speech at the state dinner was rich in substance.
vocabulary.translation: 总统在国宴上的讲话内容充实、富有实质意义。
vocabulary.newsContext: China Daily 评论文章中写道："President Xi Jinping's speech at the state dinner ... was rich in substance."

vocabulary.example: Xi Jinping arrived at the White House for the welcome banquet.
vocabulary.translation: 习近平抵达白宫出席欢迎宴会。
vocabulary.newsContext: CGTN 报道标题："Watch: Xi Jinping arrives at White House for welcome banquet."

vocabulary.example: Trump held a welcoming ceremony for the visiting president on the White House lawn.
vocabulary.translation: 特朗普在白宫草坪为来访总统举行了欢迎仪式。
vocabulary.newsContext: China Daily 报道："Xi attends welcoming ceremony held by Trump."

vocabulary.example: The two leaders held small-group exchanges in a warm atmosphere.
vocabulary.translation: 两国元首在轻松的氛围中进行了小范围交流。
vocabulary.newsContext: China Daily 报道："Xi holds small-group exchanges with Trump."

vocabulary.example: A documentary filmmaker shared stories of kindness from World War II.
vocabulary.translation: 一位纪录片导演分享了二战时期关于善良与友谊的故事。
vocabulary.newsContext: China Daily 报道标题："Documentary filmmaker shares stories of kindness."

vocabulary.example: The boy's small act of kindness became a story remembered for a lifetime.
vocabulary.translation: 男孩这个小小的善举成为被铭记一生的故事。
vocabulary.newsContext: China Daily 报道中，中国男孩把生日鸡蛋送给受伤的美国飞行员，体现了超越国界的 kindness。

vocabulary.example: During World War II, a 7-year-old Chinese boy gave his birthday egg to an injured American airman.
vocabulary.translation: 二战期间，一名7岁的中国男孩把自己的生日鸡蛋送给了受伤的美国飞行员。
vocabulary.newsContext: China Daily 报道原文使用 "an injured American airman after the Doolittle Raid"。

vocabulary.example: In return, the airman gave the boy a penny, a coin he kept into old age.
vocabulary.translation: 作为回报，飞行员送给男孩一枚硬币，这枚硬币他一直珍藏到老。
vocabulary.newsContext: China Daily 报道："the airman gave him a penny — a coin the boy kept into old age."

vocabulary.example: The two couples visited the US National Archives together during the state visit.
vocabulary.translation: 国事访问期间，两国元首夫妇共同参观了美国国家档案馆。
vocabulary.newsContext: CGTN 报道："Xi, Peng Liyuan visit US National Archives with Trump and his wife."

vocabulary.example: The US teacher was thrilled as his story reached the White House.
vocabulary.translation: 当自己的故事传到白宫时，这位美国教师激动不已。
vocabulary.newsContext: China Daily 报道标题："US teacher thrilled as his story reaches the White House."

pattern.pattern: It is worth noting that + 从句（值得注意的是……）
pattern.example: It is worth noting that cultural exchanges have opened a window for people of the two countries to understand each other.
pattern.translation: 值得注意的是，文化交流为两国人民相互了解打开了一扇窗。
pattern.usage: 用于引出需要读者特别关注的观点或事实，常见于新闻评论与议论文。也可替换为 It is worth mentioning that… / It should be noted that…

grammar.title: as 引导时间状语从句（当……时 / 随着……）
grammar.explanation: as 引导时间状语从句时，表示主句动作与从句动作同时发生，或某一动作伴随另一动作的进展而变化，常译为"当……时候""随着……"。新闻标题中常省略主语和 be 动词（如 thrilled 前省略了 he was）。
examples: US teacher thrilled as his story reaches the White House.
As the two leaders sat down for a tea chat at the White House, the world was watching closely.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 -men-，注意 -ary 弱读为 /ri/ 而不是 /əri/，中间的 /kjʊ/ 要连读顺畅，可分成 doc-u-MEN-try 四个音段慢速练习。
examples: A documentary filmmaker shares stories of kindness.
She watched a documentary about cultural exchanges across the Pacific.

reading.title: When Culture Travels: Bridges Built by Art, Archives and Kindness
reading.content:
When Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan arrived in the United States for a state visit, culture traveled with them. On Thursday, Peng and the US first lady visited the National Museum of Asian Art, where they admired works carrying centuries of Asian history. Later, the two presidential couples walked through the US National Archives, a landmark that guards a nation's memory.

Earlier in the week, a documentary filmmaker shared stories of kindness from World War II. One tells of a 7-year-old Chinese boy who gave his birthday egg to an injured American airman after the Doolittle Raid. In return, the airman gave him a penny, a coin the boy kept into old age.

Culture and travel do more than entertain. It is worth noting that museum visits, warm ceremonies and simple acts of kindness build bridges that no wall can block, reminding us that goodwill is a language everyone understands.
reading.translation:
当习近平主席与夫人彭丽媛抵达美国进行国事访问时，文化也随之同行。周四，彭丽媛与美国第一夫人参观了美国国家亚洲艺术博物馆，欣赏承载数百年亚洲历史的艺术作品；随后，两国元首夫妇共同参观了美国国家档案馆——这座保存国家记忆的建筑。

本周早些时候，一位纪录片导演分享了二战时期的善意故事：杜立特突袭行动后，一名7岁的中国男孩把自己的生日鸡蛋送给受伤的美国飞行员，作为回报，飞行员送给他一枚硬币，这枚硬币他珍藏了一生。

文化与旅行的意义远不止娱乐。值得注意的是，博物馆之行、温暖的仪式与朴素的善意，构筑起任何高墙都无法阻断的桥梁，提醒我们：善意是一种人人都懂的语言。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily 与 CGTN 2026年9月26日关于习近平主席访美、两国元首夫妇参观美国国家亚洲艺术博物馆与国家档案馆、纪录片导演讲述二战感人故事等真实报道改写。
